description: CEWEP, the European association of waste-to-energy plant operators, publishes an interactive map and a yearly map of waste-to-energy (incineration with energy recovery) plants in Europe, compiled from national sources and from its members. Coverage: the interactive map is based on 2022 data and gives location and capacity for almost 500 plants in 23 European countries, with some more recent plants in some countries; the yearly PDF maps run from 2010 to 2023, the 2023 map noting that treatment capacity was stable with a small increase over 2022; the same data page also carries charts of municipal waste treatment based on Eurostat (2017 to 2024), country reports for 2016 and 2018, a residual waste treatment capacity factsheet and a circular economy calculation tool. Format and access: a web map where a click on a country shows its plants and their capacities, and yearly PDF maps; free and without login. Licence: reproduction is authorised provided the source is acknowledged, save where otherwise stated, per the site's copyright notice. Caveats: plant figures are mostly permitted capacity, while national figures are waste treated, so the two are not comparable; CEWEP states the map is for information only and does not guarantee complete accuracy; no downloadable plant table was found on the pages read. Simulation uses: locating and sizing waste-to-energy plants for waste flow, district heating and capacity planning models. Related records: the Syctom incinerator emissions data (data-syctom-incinerator-emissions) cover plants near Paris.
